eatingOutPriceLevel.basis: Price level of restaurants and hotels relative to Finland, World Bank International Comparison Program 2021.
eatingOutPriceLevel.limitations: The programme prices restaurants and hotels together, so hotel prices are part of this figure.

coldestMonthMean.basis: Average temperature of the coldest month, Valencia, climate normals 1991-2020.

warmestMonthMeanMax.basis: Average daily high of the warmest month, Valencia, climate normals 1991-2020.

decemberDaylight.basis: Sunrise to sunset on 21 December at latitude 39.47°, calculated.

foreignBornShare.basis: Foreign-born residents as a share of the population of the city (Urban Audit, DE2009I).
foreignBornShare.limitations: Eurostat's figure is for its 'greater city' of Valencia, which takes in neighbouring municipalities as well as the city itself.

cityWide.basis: €16.30 per m² × 50 m², the app's assumed size for 1 bedroom.
cityWide.limitations: Average asking rent per m² on idealista for the city of Valencia in September 2026; no split by size or district.

rent.adjustment: Converted from a rent per m² at 50 m².

cityWide.basis: €16.30 per m² × 70 m², the app's assumed size for 2 bedrooms.
cityWide.limitations: Average asking rent per m² on idealista for the city of Valencia in September 2026; no split by size or district.

rent.adjustment: Converted from a rent per m² at 70 m².

cityWide.basis: €16.30 per m² × 90 m², the app's assumed size for 3 bedrooms.
cityWide.limitations: Average asking rent per m² on idealista for the city of Valencia in September 2026; no split by size or district.

rent.adjustment: Converted from a rent per m² at 90 m².

cityWide.basis: €16.30 per m² × 110 m², the app's assumed size for 4 bedrooms.
cityWide.limitations: Average asking rent per m² on idealista for the city of Valencia in September 2026; no split by size or district.

rent.adjustment: Converted from a rent per m² at 110 m².

1.basis: Electricity: 2,000 kWh a year (app assumption for 1 bedroom) at €0.2669 per kWh, the national household price with taxes.
1.limitations: Electricity use is an app assumption and varies with appliances, cooking and cooling.

2.basis: Electricity: 2,700 kWh a year (app assumption for 2 bedrooms) at €0.2669 per kWh, the national household price with taxes.
2.limitations: Electricity use is an app assumption and varies with appliances, cooking and cooling.

3.basis: Electricity: 3,400 kWh a year (app assumption for 3 bedrooms) at €0.2669 per kWh, the national household price with taxes.
3.limitations: Electricity use is an app assumption and varies with appliances, cooking and cooling.

4.basis: Electricity: 4,000 kWh a year (app assumption for 4 bedrooms) at €0.2669 per kWh, the national household price with taxes.
4.limitations: Electricity use is an app assumption and varies with appliances, cooking and cooling.

waterPerPerson.basis: Average water and sanitation cost in the Valencian Community in 2024 (€2.63 per m³) at the measured average use of 151 litres a person a day (INE).

transitPassAdult.basis: SUMA Mensual for one zone (A, the city of Valencia), valid on metro, tram and EMT buses: €35, or €21 with the Generalitat's 40% reduction, which runs to 31 December 2026.
transitPassAdult.limitations: Read from republished fare tables (ValenciaMove, redtransporte.com); Metrovalencia's own page could not be read. €35 a month if the reduction ends.

healthcarePerPerson.basis: Household out-of-pocket health spending per inhabitant in Spain (€647.45 a year).
healthcarePerPerson.limitations: A national average across all ages; spending is lower for most working-age adults and higher for older people.

childcarePerChild.basis: Nursery education for children under three is free in the Valencian Community in 2026–2027 (public centres, and aid of up to €460 a month for authorised private ones). Meals are charged: in the Generalitat's own nurseries at most €78.27 a month, the rate for household incomes above four times the minimum wage.
childcarePerChild.limitations: Meal prices fall with household income and differ in municipal and private nurseries. From age three, school is free; meals are still charged.

groceriesPerAdultEquivalent.basis: Average spending in Finland on food and drink at home, €362 a month per adult equivalent in 2024, priced here: prices are 0.88 times Finland's.
groceriesPerAdultEquivalent.limitations: Price levels from the 2021 international comparison, moved to 2024 with overall inflation; national prices, so the city itself may differ.

communicationsPerAdultEquivalent.basis: Average spending in Finland on phone and internet (services and devices), €70 a month per adult equivalent in 2024, priced here: prices are 1.20 times Finland's.
communicationsPerAdultEquivalent.limitations: Price levels from the 2021 international comparison, moved to 2024 with overall inflation; national prices, so the city itself may differ.

eatingOut.basis: Average spending in Finland on eating out and hotels, €196 a month per adult equivalent in 2024, priced here: prices are 0.64 times Finland's.
eatingOut.limitations: Price levels from the 2021 international comparison, moved to 2024 with overall inflation; national prices, so the city itself may differ.

recreation.basis: Average spending in Finland on leisure and holidays, €251 a month per adult equivalent in 2024, priced here: prices are 0.77 times Finland's.
recreation.limitations: Price levels from the 2021 international comparison, moved to 2024 with overall inflation; national prices, so the city itself may differ.

clothing.basis: Average spending in Finland on clothes and shoes, €111 a month per adult equivalent in 2024, priced here: prices are 0.78 times Finland's.
clothing.limitations: Price levels from the 2021 international comparison, moved to 2024 with overall inflation; national prices, so the city itself may differ.
